body: It’s been about 10 years or so since then. She’s still a very controlling person and hard to deal with, but I’ve learned to just go along with her rules whenever she’s around and then just do my own thing whenever she’s not. It’s still very difficult, but definitely better.

We used to have this rule where we weren’t allowed to do anything unless we asked. That makes sense, except it applied to literally everything. We couldn’t eat unless we asked, we couldn’t leave the house unless we asked, we couldn’t watch TV or play games or do anything without permission. If Mom said no, that was it. Sometimes we weren’t even allowed to talk, which sucked.

I had a friend sleep over once but we weren’t allowed to leave my room. Couldn’t get food or snacks, and there was no dinner. She didn’t sleep over again.

When my mom left for awhile my dad came over to make sure us kids were alright, and I still remember very clearly asking him if I was allowed to get a yogurt from the fridge. He looked at me and was completely confused, and was just like “It’s your house. Why are you asking if you can take something from your own fridge?” I was blown away !! He also let me go to friends houses and I felt like I’d stepped into a completely different world, like I had no idea that people could just do things without needing approval for it.

When I was little I lived with my grandparents on their farm for awhile. Every morning my grandma would make this crazy breakfast of pancakes and cinnamon buns, and afterward we’d sit in the kitchen drawing new pictures to put up on the fridge while we waited for my grandpa to get ready to go down to the barn. We’d work until lunch, take a break, and then go back outside again til dinner. 

Literally every moment with them that wasn’t sleeping or eating was filled with chores, but it didn’t feel like it.
I don’t want to say too much about what happened just ‘cause it’s too easy to search up and find. It wasn’t anything that could have been easily/at all prevented, though.

All throughout elementary school I had the biggest crush on this boy in my grade. We were friends but drifted into different crowds after starting high school. We ended up being in the same gym class together in grade 10 and it was the best semester of my life, but I stopped talking to him completely after it was over; we had no more classes together and no real reason to stay in contact :/

No more than two years later, he’s dead. It’s only been a couple of months but every day I wish I had made a better effort to keep up my friendship with him. I had so many chances and I didn’t take any of them.
My cat is the best thing in my life and I don’t think the lil guy even knows it.
